user.title: Link your PostNL account
user.description:
### Linking your PostNL account

1. [Download the PostNL Home Assistant Login Helper]({helper_url}) and extract the ZIP file. The helper is a Google Chrome extension.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, enable **Developer mode**, and choose **Load unpacked**. Select the extracted helper folder.
3. Open [PostNL sign-in]({auth_url}) and sign in to your PostNL account.
4. The helper automatically captures the `postnl://login?...` callback. Click the helper icon in Chrome and choose **Copy callback**.
5. Return to Home Assistant, paste the callback below, and complete the sign-in process.

data_description.callback_url: Paste the full callback URL beginning with postnl://login?code=...

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect PostNL
reauth_confirm.description:
Your PostNL session has expired.

1. Make sure the [PostNL Home Assistant Login Helper]({helper_url}) is loaded in Chrome.
2. Open [PostNL sign-in]({auth_url}) and sign in again.
3. Copy the captured `postnl://login?...` callback from the helper and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: The PostNL sign-in is invalid or has expired. Try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach PostNL or process the callback. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This PostNL account is already configured.
